shorts.title: Adani SEBI case settled. Clean chit?
The line in Adani's SEBI order
shorts.hook: Read this line|in Adani's SEBI order

beats.say: The Adani SEBI case is settled. Four Adani companies paid thirty seven lakh rupees each to close SEBI's six year public shareholding case. So is this a clean chit? By the end of this video you'll know exactly what the order says, and what it doesn't.
beats.cap: The Adani SEBI case is settled. Four Adani companies paid ₹37.05 lakh each to close SEBI's six-year public shareholding case. So is this a clean chit? By the end of this video you'll know exactly what the order says, and what it doesn't.

beats.say: Chapter one. What SEBI alleged against Adani.
beats.cap: Chapter one. What SEBI alleged against Adani.
cues: Chapter one.
What SEBI alleged against Adani.

beats.say: It started with complaints in June and July twenty twenty, that some Adani group companies were not meeting India's minimum public shareholding rules. Those rules decide how much of a listed company must be owned by the public.
beats.cap: It started with complaints in June and July 2020, that some Adani group companies were not meeting India's minimum public shareholding (MPS) rules. Those rules decide how much of a listed company must be owned by the public.
cues: It started with complaints in June and July 2020,
that some Adani group companies were not meeting India's minimum public
shareholding (MPS) rules.
Those rules decide how much of a listed company must be owned by the public.

beats.say: SEBI opened an investigation in October twenty twenty. It issued a show cause notice in September twenty twenty four, and added more material in March twenty twenty five.
beats.cap: SEBI opened an investigation in October 2020. It issued a show cause notice in September 2024, and added more material in March 2025.
cues: SEBI opened an investigation in October 2020.
It issued a show cause notice in September 2024,
and added more material in March 2025.

beats.say: Four companies were in it: Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports, and Adani Energy Solutions, once called Adani Transmission. Fourteen current and former directors, including Gautam Adani, applied to settle alongside them.
beats.cap: Four companies were in it: Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports, and Adani Energy Solutions (formerly Adani Transmission). Fourteen current and former directors, including Gautam Adani, applied to settle alongside them.

Adani Enterprises, Adani Power, Adani Ports,
and Adani Energy Solutions (formerly Adani Transmission).

applied to settle alongside them.

beats.say: Chapter two. How the Adani SEBI settlement works.
beats.cap: Chapter two. How the Adani SEBI settlement works.

How the Adani SEBI settlement works.

beats.say: The terms were the same for every company: thirty seven lakh five thousand rupees, paid jointly and severally with its directors. Four companies make about one point four eight crore rupees in total.
beats.cap: The terms were the same for every company: ₹37,05,000, paid jointly and severally with its directors. Four companies make about ₹1.48 crore in total.

₹37,05,000, paid jointly and severally with its directors.
Four companies make about ₹1.48 crore in total.

beats.say: It took a year. SEBI's committees met in September twenty twenty five and May twenty twenty six. The whole time members approved it in August. The money was paid on the twenty sixth of August, and the order was passed on the twenty eighth of September.
beats.cap: It took a year. SEBI's committees met in September 2025 and May 2026. The whole-time members approved it in August. The money was paid on 26 August, and the order was passed on 28 September.

Clean chit?

beats.say: Check one. Was anything found? No. The applicants settled without admitting or denying the facts and conclusions of law. That is not a clean chit, and it is not a finding of guilt either.
beats.cap: Check one. Was anything found? No. The applicants settled "without admitting or denying the facts and conclusions of law". That is not a clean chit, and it is not a finding of guilt either.

beats.say: Check two. Is it final? For the applicants, yes. SEBI says it shall not initiate any other enforcement action for these allegations. But it can restore the case if a representation proves untrue or an undertaking is breached.
beats.cap: Check two. Is it final? For the applicants, yes. SEBI "shall not initiate any other enforcement action" for these allegations. But it can restore the case if a representation proves untrue or an undertaking is breached.

beats.say: Check three, the line we promised. The show cause notice went to various entities including the applicants. The order settles only the eighteen applicants. Anyone else named in the notice is not covered, and the order doesn't say where they stand.

beats.say: And this is not the only settlement this month. On the twenty second of September, Adani Energy Solutions separately disclosed a nine lakh seventy five thousand rupee settlement, under a different listing rule.
beats.cap: And this is not the only settlement this month. On 22 September, Adani Energy Solutions separately disclosed a ₹9,75,000 settlement, under a different listing rule (Clause 41(l)(h) of the old Listing Agreement).

beats.say: The bear case. Nothing was found, so nothing is cleared. Others named in the notice are not covered. SEBI can reopen it. And a six year case ending at one point four eight crore can be read either way.

beats.say: Now the moat. A public float case is not about ports, power plants or transmission lines. It is about who owns the shares. So none of the four moats changes. MoatSCORE calls this ungoverned risk, which we track but never score.
